user.title: Mercedes Eco Coach
user.description: Enter your VIN. Choose browser login (confirmed) or experimental direct login (no callback copying). An existing access token can also be entered.

direct.title: Experimental direct Mercedes login
direct.description: Enter your Mercedes account credentials for one login attempt. Home Assistant sends the password to Mercedes but does NOT store it in the config entry. MFA and additional confirmation screens are not supported; cancel and use browser login if needed.

data.username: Mercedes account email or phone number

callback.title: Complete Mercedes sign-in
callback.description: Copy the prefilled authorization URL into a desktop browser (not your phone) and sign in. When the browser cannot open the Eco Coach app, copy the COMPLETE `ecocoach://login/callback?...` URL from its address bar or history into the callback field within 10 minutes. Never share the callback URL.

data.authorization_url: Copy this URL and open it in your desktop browser

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Eco Coach token
reauth_confirm.description: Leave the token empty to start another login, select experimental direct login, or enter a replacement bearer token.

error.invalid_auth: Mercedes rejected the authorization, or the callback was invalid or expired. Start a new login if needed.
error.unsupported_login: Mercedes requires an additional or changed login step. Cancel and use browser login instead.
error.statistics_verification_failed: Mercedes login completed, but Eco Coach could not verify this vehicle's statistics. Do not retry your password; check the Home Assistant log for the failing statistics step.
error.mfa_required: Mercedes requires MFA. Cancel and use browser login instead.
error.cannot_connect: The Mercedes login or Eco Coach statistics server could not be reached.
error.invalid_response: The login or statistics server returned an unsupported response.
